objective: Measure propagation rounds and untangling phases for the atom and not-all-equal laws on six-regular weaves (triangular tori) and on the same patterns after degree-preserving knot swaps, at the sample jump of the forced set, against frozen predictions.
status: Supported 2026-11-17 (referee pending): frozen run of 431 cases, gates held, P >= D in all 2,130 readings; 9 of 10 predictions held (T4 failed: P*/D* 3.7..6.3). Two-demand law: on the weave a kernel grows one step per phase, P* = 256 at L = 384 (= 2L/3, the weave's largest steps apart), against 9.5 on the role-preserving twin (mean-field jump, k*/n 0.086); one-demand and planted NAE: no jump, flat phases.
title: Rounds against untangling phases on weaves and their non-spatial twins
